messages.text:
The Magic Miner 40T is 15 lb, so it falls on the $40 flat worldwide shipping bracket to Australia. You'd get the EU-type plug, which is fine there with a cheap adapter.

At 650 W it's about 468 kWh a month — what do you pay per kWh?
Solar and battery so the cost is about 2 cents per kWh

At 2 cents, the 40T costs about $9 a month to run — that's as cheap as home mining gets.

So the jackpot shot is basically free: 40 TH/s drawing at a full block every ten minutes, round the clock, for years, plus steady sats to your own wallet in between. Best value per TH we sell at $799.

Want me to build the cart?
